about_the_game:
You are a dog. Your entire purpose in life is herding sheep. Other players are also dogs. They also want to herd sheep. They want to herd more sheep than you. You will not let that happen. 

About:

Wiz-Herd is a local and online party game where 2-4 players compete in fast-paced minigames. Herd sheep, cast spells, and sabotage your friends to claim victory!

Spells:

Choose 3 of the 9 available spells to take into the minigame gauntlet. Experiment to discover the best combos and counters!

  • Wind: Blast away dogs and sheep alike with a powerful gust of wind.

  • Block: Barricade goals or paths with an impenetrable wall.

  • Charm: Attract all nearby sheep instead of scaring them away for a short time.

  • Confuse: Invert the controls for all nearby opponents.

  • Speed Up: Increase your movement speed and zoom around the arena.

  • Speed Down: Decrease movement speed for nearby opponents.

  • Mine: Place down a trap that will blow away everything when it gets triggered.

  • Stun: Zap nearby players and stop them from moving for a bit.

  • Grow: Increase your size as well as your ability to move sheep.

Minigames:

  • Shepherding: Collect more sheep into your pen than your competitors.

  • Soccer: Keep the ball (sheep) out of your own goal while trying to score on your opponents.

  • Race: Get your sheep over the finish line before anyone else.

  • King of the Hill: Herd your sheep onto the hill to claim ownership and earn more points than your competitors.

  • Floor is Lava: Maneuver your sheep off of the falling tiles and be the last one standing.
